task: 09 compares the image config os/architecture with the inventory's recorded collapsed_to platform (#124)

events.summary: lib/verify-oci-layout.py (09 path) now reads each verified image's config blob and, when the inventory entry has collapsed_to (<os>/<arch>), requires config os and architecture to equal it exactly; an unlocated config, unreadable config, non-object config, or missing/ill-typed field is a reported problem, never a pass; entries with collapsed_to null skip the check; config_blob is stripped from --report-out rows. Tests: Layout.image() gains arch/os/variant (default arm64/linux), 10 new tests in test_oci_inventory.py. 02, 05 and the inventory schema untouched; no registry, no network.

Pre-change reproduction: one-image bundle whose config says architecture arm64 while the inventory entry's collapsed_to is linux/amd64. origin/main 09 accepts it (the gap); HEAD 09 rejects it naming the image and both platforms. A matching bundle (config amd64, collapsed_to linux/amd64) passes on both.
